selection_rule: Use two only if both families gain >=10% median throughput, CV<=25%, p95<=3x single and all trials have zero infrastructure errors; otherwise retain one.
workload_control: All repetitions and collector counts use the identical engine seed 7000 and layout seed0; repetitions vary execution, not the sampled scene.
scope: Collector environment only, including durable dispatch logging/RGB/targets; no learner overlap or GPU inference.

runtime.scope: observed_development_simulator_stack; not a CUDA/PyTorch training-host validation

selected_iwad.selection: explicit bundled freedoom2.wad; each worker verifies engine path and hash

renderer.native_barrier: both set_action then shared barrier then advance_action(1); four tics per logical decision
renderer.coordinated_reset: fresh participant processes and isolated episode working directories

license_provenance.original_vizdoom_code: MIT; bundled engine components retain their separate licenses
license_provenance.generated_pwads: Original project geometry and scripts; no copied IWAD sprites/textures in generated PWADs.
license_provenance.redistribution: Preserve upstream Freedoom credits/license when distributing the IWAD; do not label the entire engine bundle MIT.
